description: Agent-harness lifecycle hooks for Codex CLI

hooks.command: jq -n '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"<system-reminder>\nThis project uses the agent-workflow plan→spec→memory loop. Before starting a task: read the root AGENTS.md, pick the target workspace (apps/<name> or packages/<name>), read its .agents/session-log.md and .agents/lessons.md, and write a .agents/todo.md plan. Enter plan mode for non-trivial tasks (3+ steps).\n</system-reminder>"}}'

jq -n '{"systemMessage":"<system-reminder>\nPlan updated. Before the first implementation Edit/Write, create the task directory under the target workspace (<workspace>/.agents/artifacts/task_<YYYY_MM_DD>_<slug>/) and write 1_plan.md (phase: plan, status: approved) and 2_spec.md (phase: spec) following the agent-workflow skill templates.\n</system-reminder>"}'
bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/turborepo-harness-template/core/scripts/memory-gate.sh" --json | jq 'if .decision == "block" then {"systemMessage":(.reason)} else empty end'
